headline: Executive order on making federal contracting and hiring practices serve the interests of American workers.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to look at how they hire workers and award contracts, with the goal of favoring American workers. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their contracting practices may face new review or requirements related to the workers they use.
They are directed to review or change how they hire people and award contracts.

who_it_affects.group: People seeking federal jobs or jobs with federal contractors
who_it_affects.how: Hiring practices for these jobs may change to focus on American workers.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 3, 2020; the source does not give specific effective dates or deadlines.
